newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends 1.4 lower vs dlr at 1,076.40.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends 1.4 lower vs dlr at 1,076.40.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 1.4 pesos lower against the dollar at 1,076.40 in active but mostly sideways trading, interbank dealers said.
"The market was stable; it was very different from the last few days, which were very volatile and nervous," one trader said.
With few dollar sellers, after the peso hit a low of 1,080.00 in trading Thursday, dealers said the peso dropped on limited demand for U.S. currency from the corporate sector.
Dealers reported an above-average 458 trades for a total of $213 million and said the peso held in a 1,074-to-1,079.50 range.
